name: SALAD-Bench
description: A hierarchical and comprehensive safety benchmark for LLMs with a three-level taxonomy covering diverse harmful categories: forbidden, controversial, and sensitive. Includes both base queries and attack/defense-enhanced variants (with jailbreaks and safety prompts). Introduces MD-Judge, an LLM-based safety evaluator competitive with Llama Guard 2. Contains questions at different challenge levels for systematic safety profiling.
evaluation_method: safety violation rate; MD-Judge LLM-based scoring
general_score_metric: safety violation rate (% responses violating safety policy; lower is better)
typical_sota_score: Top safety-aligned models: <5% violation rate on base queries; 15–40% on enhanced attack variants
reputation: Published at ACL 2024; referenced by Meta's Llama Guard team; active HuggingFace leaderboard; introduces MD-Judge evaluator; hierarchical taxonomy enables fine-grained safety profiling
notes: ACL 2024. Three-level taxonomy: 6 top-level domains → 16 mid-level categories → 66 fine-grained sub-categories. Attack-enhanced queries apply 10+ jailbreak techniques. MD-Judge is a fine-tuned safety judge competitive with commercial options and hosted on HuggingFace. Referenced by Meta's Llama Guard development team. Active HuggingFace leaderboard.
